synopsis: Oceania. The Ministry of Truth. Big Brother watches. You buy a diary on impulse. Today you write: down with Big Brother.

nodes.text: Cream-laid pages. The pen scratches. The telescreen, you hope, can't see your hands.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You die some years later, unnoticed, with the right songs on your lips. Whatever you thought before is, finally, gone.
You buy paper. You write. You bury it. Two centuries later a scholar finds the box and asks who you were.
On your worst nights you remember the meadow. The first kiss. The single hour you were, in fact, a free person. You decide the hour was worth the rest. You don't tell anyone.
